name: @opendatalabs/personal-server-ts-server
description: Hono HTTP server for the Vana Personal Server — routes, middleware, composition root

scripts.build:bundle: mkdir -p dist/bundle && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/bundle/enclave-main.mjs --external:better-sqlite3 --external:pino --external:pino-pretty --external:secp256k1 --external:thread-stream --packages=bundle --banner:js="import { createRequire as __bundleCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; import { fileURLToPath as __bundleFileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; import { dirname as __bundleDirname } from 'node:path'; const require = __bundleCreateRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = __bundleFileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = __bundleDirname(__filename);" && cp package.json dist/package.json && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.build: tsc --build && npm run copy-ui && npm run build:bundle
